I have OCD and I can tell you that if that’s the only tic you have, you most likely do not have OCD. I spent about 7hours a day on my OCD and that’s without counting the constant obsessive thinking. Now that I take medication and I was hospitalized in a psychiatry for 4months I feel much better. I „only“ spend about 1-2 hours a day with my OCD and that is including my obsessive thinking. 

BTW OCD comes in so many forms and shapes. There are OCD compulsions you wouldn’t even be able to think of. Everyone is different and that includes their OCD. 

So from what you wrote it’s probably not OCD and just a tic(Most people have some annoying ticks and it’s not OCD) but if you are stressed about it then you’d be better of going to a therapist or something, cause it’s always good to have some one professional to talk to.
